blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Minerals are the fundamental building blocks of rocks.
A mineral is a naturally occurring, inorganic substance.
Minerals are characterized by a definite chemical composition and a crystalline structure.
Competitive exams often test the definition of a mineral: it must be naturally occurring and inorganic.
Key diagnostic features of minerals include a definite chemical composition and an ordered crystalline structure.
